heading: Data Sources

text: DUF4041 PF13250/IPR025280 was used to identify SNIPE homologues; PF01541 was rejected as the wrong nuclease-family marker.
quote: SNIPE homologues identified by DUF4041 (PF13250 / IPR025280) Pfam domain in eggNOG annotations. GIY-YIG (PF01541) was queried independently but found to be the wrong Pfam family — the SNIPE nuclease is PF13455 (Mug113, GIY-YIG clan CL0418).
heading: Domain Detection

text: Environmental embedding differences were tested using Welch's t-test with Bonferroni correction for 64 tests; effect size used Cohen's d with pooled standard deviation.
quote:
- AlphaEarth dimension comparison: Welch's t-test with Bonferroni correction (64 tests)
- Effect sizes: Cohen's d with pooled standard deviation
heading: Statistical Tests

text: giy_yig_species.csv lists 728 species with GIY-YIG from a 1,000-cluster sample; this is a sample-derived count, not an exhaustive species count.
quote: - `giy_yig_species.csv` — 728 species with GIY-YIG (from 1,000-cluster sample)
